notes.title: 💚 New Visual Novel Announced 💜
notes.content:
[quote=author]Since the battle, Stars Reach Castle has been peaceful and light. However, for a certain two elves, things haven't been going quite right... Is it the result of a contest with tunics most wet, or perhaps two personalities that conflict and don't set, a feud has erupted between two elves that just met.
From training proclivity to fun time activity, no matter the task, no matter the reason, these girls have not limit, well except maybe treason. Has Eleanna's want to be the best gone from desire to obsessed? Or have Zariinna's reprisals gone from taunts to torments? This rivalry is sure to get worse before it relents, and soon comes the time to give your two cents.

[b]As Champion of Stars Reach, strong-bodied and good health, do you have what it takes to determine who is best elf?[/b]
[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/a728bd6429ab0bd89876da4ff2342edba0c71737.png[/img]

[i]Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf is a stand-alone visual novel featuring 🔞 content. The timeline takes place according to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/630550/Faulty_Apprentice__Fantasy_Dating_Sim/]true good ending of Faulty Apprentice[/url]. However, players will not need to have played the original game or DLC to enjoy this story.[/i]

💘 [b] This is a lighthearted dating sim that features hand-painted reward illustrations, Live2d animations, and high-quality voice acting.[/b] There will not be any minigames or good/evil routes like in the original Faulty Apprentice game, but the choices you make will unlock different reward scenes, so choose wisely! 

[h2]Wishlist [url=http://bit.ly/BestElf]Faulty Apprentice: Best Elf[/url] on Steam now![/h2] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1583240

[i]We will start releasing artwork and the rough draft of the story starting May 10th on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/dinmoney]Patreon[/url]! [/i]

notes.title: 18+ DLC Download Issue FIXED
notes.content:
Greeting Apprentices! 
After countless nights and with the help of a Steam staff, our programmer has finally found the source of the issue for 18+ DLC! Thank you for your patients!

[h3]Here are some things you could do to resolve the issue:[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Log out of Steam > Log Back in- This should work in most cases, the game will Auto-Update.

[*] To force update you can try: Right Click Faulty Apprentice > Properties > DLC > Make sure you have all current 3 DLC.

[*] Steam should Auto-Update if not turn checkbox off and back off to force update.

[*] You can also go to Properties> Local files > Verify integrity of game files. 
[/olist]

[b]Don't forget to join our [url=http://discord.gg/AGLstudioart]Discord channel[/url] or comment in this thread to let us know if the problem is successfully fixed on your end!
[/b]

notes.title: First DLC is now LIVE and FREE!
notes.content:
[h3]Join Durandall and the Stars Reach Instructors on an adventure to the most perilous, pointiest, and prickliest peek that's ever protruded into the cumulus, Borg Mountain! [/h3]


If suspicion is correct, there is a secret cave containing an important clue to finding the evil sorcerer, Vaultes. However, its location is surrounded by monsters, protected with magic and shrouded in mystery. Will you and your friends be able to unravel the mountain's secrets and unlock the hidden treasure within? 

❄️❄️❄️❄️❄️ [h3][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1212690/Faulty_Apprentice__Escape_from_Borg_Mountain/][b]Play the first Faulty Apprentice FREE title update, "Escape From Borg Mountain" to find out! [/b][/url][/h3] ❄️❄️❄️❄️❄️

[u]This update takes place after the Main Story[/u], so if you have not completed the base game yet, be sure to finish before starting this DLC to avoid major spoilers. [u][b]You will also need to have a save data from Day 17[/b][/u].

✅ First and foremost is [b]fully voiced dialogue[/b]! Now you can hear full sentences by the talented voice actresses.

✅ However, due to the overwhelmingly negative response to the mini-games by the Steam community, these will be [b]the last mini-games[/b] we'll be doing for the series.  So, we urge you to give them one last chance!

notes.title: Faulty Apprentice v.1.0.12 patch notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/de19d3a1852e428402ac2d212d69cc4504d66d29.png[/img]
[b]Hail Apprentices![/b] We know you're all busy with War Preparations, but the Royal Commander wishes to relay some new information.

[h1]Main additions / changes:[/h1][list]
[*] Black Screen at start of the game: We believe is possibly caused by some old GPU's that have hard time loading the game. This issue should now be fixed, but if it happens again, please let us know.

[*] Skip function is now available! This enables you to skip dialogue until an important story choice comes up. It could also be adjusted in the Setting section. (Located at the bottom left of the screen.) 

[*] Now along with left-click, you could also proceed with the story dialogue using the spacebar! We know, this is pretty expected for VN's, so we apologize for not getting it in sooner!

[*] Fire is with or against you! The Cinder Guard previously had fewer dialogue opportunities than other Guards, so we've added a couple more! But be warned, if you thought it was hard to Talk to her before... Well, you'll see.

[*] CLIMAX!!! We've updated a pivotal choice during the final battle. Players complained that it was a forced choice so we made it more interactive with additional consequences to help the story flow closer to how we envisioned it. 

[*] Gallery! Bug saying "Click to interact" with non-interactable images in gallery has been fixed!

[*] Missing Achievements are now fixed!

[*] Typos and other small tweaks!
[/list]

[b]Thanks to all the Apprentices that gave us feedback![/b] While we may not be able to accommodate every request as a small (two guys, one gal) studio, we certainly listen to every request.[b] If you haven't left a review yet, please do.[/b] (It give Stars Reach Castle POWER!!) 

[b]Faulty Apprentice contains more secrets than the Dark Elf prisoner[/b], so don't be shy joining our discord seeking aide from your fellow Apprentices! On the other side of the battlefield, if you've already completed the goals of your apprenticeship, [b]please join to help out new apprentices![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34244145/4ebf9ef7663187baf8c8b65592cc0135fbfde0c2.png[/img]
[b]AGL Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/AGLstudioArt

[b]Thank you for playing Faulty Apprentice! [/b]
Din + AGL Team

notes.content:

It has been a long road rebuilding Faulty Apprentice from scratch in Unity Engine, but we are incredibly proud of what our humble game has become. Not only have we[b] completed ALL of our Stretch Goal in-game content [/b]from out initial Kickstarter Campaign, but with the help of our Patreon Supporters we've[b] added even MORE![/b] What more, you ask? Customizable features such as Banners and Titles, partial Voice Acting for the Guards, new Locations, Master Equipment sets, and even a few Secret Scenes (= 

As a special thank you to everyone that supported Faulty Apprentice on Kickstarter and preordered on BackerKit, we will b[b]e releasing Chapter 2 in a couple of weeks [/b]as well as a [b]beta version of the full game when we are closer to release.[/b] If you are not a Patron supporter and wish to play chapter 2, you must [b][u][url=https://faultyapprentice.backerkit.com/hosted_preorders]preorder before August 8, 2019[/url][/u] [/b] 
Join our [url=https://www.patreon.com/dinmoney]patreon[/url] to play Chapter 2 and more now! 

[h1][b][u]Patreon Supporters with lifetime pledge of $20 or more will receive a download code for full game at time of release![/u][/b][/h1]

We are excited to share our hard work with you all, and hope you are excited, too! Please look forward to more updates and once again, thank you for supporting Faulty Apprentice!

[b]Comment [/b]what you're looking forward to the most in the final game and hit that[b] Like[/b] button if you're hyped!

notes.title: ☘️🥚☘️ Faulty Apprentice: Spring Event ☘️🥚☘️
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34244145/d2759a20da88fe5c12ab86ce56e3a2f27c41d2c6.png[/img]

☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️

One of King Isaac's first acts coming into power was an attempt to encourage trading with other nations and promote fertility in the harvests to come. A great farming market would fill the Lower Courtyard of Stars Reach every springtime, thus becoming known as the[b] [u]Spring Festival[/u][/b]. Traders from Northmark, Bunnington, Atlantis, and the Sand Skirts would bring all sorts of soils, seeds, and saplings. At least they would under normal circumstances, but with the declaration of siege, all trade has been shut down.

However, there is [b][u]one tradition[/u][/b] of the Spring Festival that [b][u]cannot be shut down[/u][/b], at least not while your favorite bunny guard Hilde is on duty! During Springtime at the Burrow, all the [b][u]bunny folk host a town-wide Egg hunt[/u][/b] for all the children. Since all the younglings at Stars Reach have been evacuated, Hilde is changing the rules to make it more fun for the Guards and you! 

Each member of the [b][u]Castle Guards have been given an egg to paint and hide[/u][/b] somewhere in Stars Reach! While some girls may take hiding their eggs more seriously than others, as part of the rules they must all [b]give you a hint[/b] as to where their egg is hidden before you can start looking for it. 

[b][u][h1]Depending on how many you find[/h1][/u][/b]will affect how much fun you and Hilde will have on your picnic date afterward ❤️❤️❤️

☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️

[h1] [b]How to play![/b][/h1] 
[olist]
    [*] Download FA Demo ft. Spring Event game build on [u]April 9th[/u]
    [*] Accept the [u]Event Job[/u] from Hilde at the South Tower
    [*] Find as many Eggs as you can, then[h1] bring them back to Hilde to go on a picnic date![/h1]
[/olist]

The Faulty Apprentice Event Job: Bunny-bunny Egg Hunt will be[b] [u]available to everyone for a limited time[/u][/b]. There will be[b] [u]Good and Bad endings[/u][/b] if you are playing a Chapter One build, but if you wish to achieve the Ultimate Romance ending you will need to find eggs from Guards and locations that do not unlock until Chapter Two.

☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️☘️🥚☘️🥚☘️

Comment below which Guard's Egg you think will be the most difficult to locate and hit that Like button if you're going to[b][u][h1]unlock Hilde's Ultimate ending![/h1][/u][/b]

[h1]☘️🥚☘️[b]Spring Event April 9th - May 9th[/b] ☘️🥚☘️[/h1]

See you soon, sugar! ❤️❤️❤️

Thank you for playing Faulty Apprentice! If you are not already, please consider supporting Faulty Apprentice on Patreon <3
